title: Prepared ledger provenance remediation architecture audit

identity_contract.requirement: Each simultaneously live logical mass ledger that exposes prepare_trial must be bound to a stable positive ledger_id unique within that runtime ownership domain before external preparation.
identity_contract.validation: The ledger rejects unbound external preparation, invalid non-positive identity, rebinding to a different identity, foreign identity and stale generation before publication.

invariants.note: No alternate SWAP kernel is introduced.
Mass-ledger code remains free of file, path, parser and format I/O.
Committed accounting, trial state and prepared reservation state remain explicitly separated.
Persistent state grows only by one int64 ledger identity; immutable model parameters are unaffected.
No solver scratch, Jacobian or Newton state is added to a column.
O(1) scalar identity and generation checks remain compatible with pools, batches and SoA storage.
External prepare requires explicit ledger identity and commit/abort reject foreign identity or stale generation before mutation; trial/prepare/commit/abort semantics remain transactional.
No restriction is introduced on cheap rerun, rollback or warm-start behavior.
Ledger exchange remains parameterized by generic coupling window t0/t1; no day, month or year unit is introduced.
No fixed 00:00 coupling window or fixed duration is assumed.
Prepared accounting publication is now provenance-safe as a coupling-core transaction primitive.
Groundwater cumulative exchange remains the exact arithmetic negative of the canonical SWAP cumulative exchange; no end-to-end aquifer claim is added.
No mass tolerance exists; abort/rejection publish no committed mass and accepted publication remains exact action-reaction under an explicitly owned ledger identity.
No response-tangent or sensitivity contract is changed.
Identity checks add constant local work and no extra SWAP solve.
One int64 identity plus local generation is lightweight and does not imply one heavy solver instance per logical column.
Ledger identity is a runtime logical-ledger identity, not a MODFLOW-cell identity; no 1-to-1 mapping is assumed.
Deep-vadose transfer remains outside this ledger.
No component-transition storage semantics are changed and no water transfer is silently introduced.
No soil-water solver implementation is selected or constrained.
No physical crop, ET, drainage, irrigation or surface process is duplicated.
No HeadCalc internal data are exposed or consumed.
Ledger identity/provenance is a runtime transaction contract and does not alter physical configuration or solver policy.
Bind, prepare validation, commit and abort remain bounded O(1) operations.
Reference-mode availability and accuracy are untouched.
Snapshots now expose whether identity is bound and the bound ledger_id, while foreign credentials cannot publish another ledger's diagnostics.
The added identity state exists only when this optional ledger component is instantiated.
Runtime/coupler explicitly owns assignment and uniqueness of ledger_id; SWAP does not infer cell/tile composition.
The previous implicit same-ledger assumption is replaced by an explicit positive stable unique ledger_id contract checked by the component.
The remediation is explicitly assessed against all 30 architecture invariants and retains the frozen blocked authority as provenance.

hard_nonclaims: Owner qualification is not independent qualification.
This branch is not current-canonical admission.
No MODFLOW adapter or aquifer solver is added.
No end-to-end predictor-corrector convergence or coupled aquifer mass closure is claimed.
No process-crash recovery or distributed transaction protocol is claimed.
No large-MultiSWAP throughput qualification is claimed.
Runtime/coupler uniqueness of ledger_id must be qualified again when this primitive is composed into a multi-ledger production runtime.
